Cell.Text: S|You there, hold fast! | I've tracked this damned bear for two weeks; I'll not let it have any more victims.

Isran? Needing someone else's help? Never thought I'd hear that. | I'm afraid he's a few years too late. I've moved on. I have more important business to attend to. | Besides, he can handle anything alone! He assured me so himself. What could he possibly need my help with?
Vampires? | That... well, that might change things. | Tell me more about what's going on.
[S] G|By the Eight... | All right, look. I'll consider it, but I can't just leave this bear to prey on more innocent people. | Once it's dealt with, then perhaps I'll see what Isran expects of me.
[S] By the Eight... | All right. I'll hear out Isran, see if there's anything I can do to help. | Where do you expect me to go?

Node.Caption: DLC1HunterBaseIntroGunmarRequestResponse2: We're not sure, but they have an Elder Scroll.

Cell.Text: [S] G|He's been working on that place for years now. Never lets anyone in. | His own little fortress. Well, I guess I'll get to see what he's been up to all this time. | I'll meet you there.
[S] G|Watch yourself. This bear is vicious.
[S] G|We need to stop this creature before it kills again.

Don't know how well I'd have managed by myself. You have my thanks. | You've helped me, so I suppose the least I can do is find out what Isran wants. He's still at that fort near Stendarr's Beacon, I assume?
For two weeks I've tracked that bear, and now find that you've killed it on your own. | I'm not sure whether that makes you brave or foolish. What brings you here?

Node.Caption: DLC1HunterBaseIntroGunmarPostBearResponse1: Yes, he said to meet him at Fort Dawnguard.

Cell.Text: If Isran is anything, he's stubborn.
